overall.summary: OUST shows two genuine disclosure degradation signals: the removal of specific quantitative expense detail from MD&A (Flag 2) and significant stripping of product roadmap specifics including development milestone updates for L4 prototypes and Chronos chip (Flag 3). However, the majority of peer divergence flags were incorrectly oriented—they actually highlight OUST's stronger disclosure relative to peers on supply chain, geopolitical, and financial sustainability topics. The core concerns are concentrated in temporal changes between the Q1 and Q2 10-Q filings.
